ESG  »  2023 ESG report
2023 ESG report
Welcome to QIC Real Estate's 2023 ESG report

From delivering our community investment program to improving our understanding of physical climate risks across our portfolio, QIC Real Estate remained focused on driving sustainability outcomes across our asset portfolio and delivering on our ESG strategy.

We welcome you to read our 2023 ESG report and find out about our environmental, community, and people programs and performance.

Click into the different sections of our report to find out more.

 

QIC respectfully acknowledges the Traditional Owners and Custodians of Country throughout Australia and recognises their continuing connection to land, sea and community. We pay our respects to Elders past, present and emerging.

Report sectionsReport sections
01
Introduction
Michael O'Brien, QIC's Managing Director - Real Estate, reflects on our ESG priorities and performance in 2023, including our progress to address climate change and community contributions.
02
Our approach
In our view, accounting for ESG risks and opportunities can lead to more informed investment decisions and better outcomes for society and the environment.
03
Our performance
We capture our key ESG data and trends and report against a number of ESG benchmarks to track our performance and compare it against our property sector peers.
04
Our progress
To continue to deliver against our ESG Strategy, we track our progress against the priority areas of Resource Efficiency & Circular Economy; Climate Change; Sustainable Value Chain; and Community Investment.
05
Our governance
QIC's active board, committees and tailored policies and standards provide the perspective and structure for efficiency and integrity in corporate governance.
06
Our people
We continue to focus on maintaining an environment that helps support and further develop our most important asset, our people.
07
Who we are
QIC was created in 1991 by the Queensland Government to serve its long-term investment responsibilities and has grown into a leading long-term specialist manager in alternatives.
08
GRI standards
Our ESG report is aligned to the Global Reporting Initiative's (GRI) Sustainability Reporting Standards in accordance with their 'Core' option.
Case studies

Delivered through our assets, we're delivering ESG initiatives valued by the communities in which we operate.
